title: 2013 HMMT November Guts Problem 8
statement:
Evaluate the expression

where the digit 2 appears 2013 times.

[Diagram omitted from this imported transcription; consult the HMMT archive while reviewing the problem.]

solutions.text: \(\frac{\frac{2013}{2014}}{}\) Let \(f(n)\) denote the corresponding expression with the digit 2 appearing exactly \(n\) times. Then \(f(1)=\frac{1}{2}\) and for \(n>1, f(n)=\frac{1}{2-f(n-1)}\). By induction using the identity \(\frac{1}{2-\frac{N-1}{N}}=\frac{N}{N+1}\), \(f(n)=\frac{n}{n+1}\) for all \(n \geq 1\), so \(f(2013)=\frac{2013}{2014}\).
